prompt: a Python 3.14 web service built with FastAPI and pydantic. POST /items accepts a JSON item with a name (string) and a quantity (integer), validates it, stores it in memory, and returns the stored item; GET /items returns every stored item in insertion order. The ASGI app object is `app` in `main.py`. Declare the project in pyproject.toml with requires-python >=3.14 and the runtime dependencies listed, with tests runnable by pytest and a README that says how to install and run it.
